description:
• About our brand and products:

At Getfiguro, we turn your most cherished photos into one-of-a-kind custom figurines. Whether it's a portrait of yourself, a loved one, a pet, or a beloved character — we bring it to life as a beautifully crafted collectible you can hold, display, and treasure. Every figurine is made to order, handcrafted with attention to detail, and shipped directly to your door. We serve gift buyers looking for something truly personal, anime and gaming fans who want to own a piece of their universe, and collectors who appreciate craftsmanship that stands out. Getfiguro isn't just a product — it's a memory made tangible.


• What makes us different:

Anyone can sell a generic figurine. Getfiguro sells yours. Here's what sets us apart: We use your actual photos to sculpt a figurine that looks like the real person, pet, or character — not a template. Our detail-first process means no two figurines are ever identical. We also offer a uniquely personal unboxing experience, with custom packaging that makes gifting feel special from the very first look. Unlike mass-market collectibles, every Getfiguro piece is made on demand — meaning it exists because someone wanted it to. That emotional connection is something you simply can't buy off a shelf.


• How affiliates can earn:

Joining the Getfiguro affiliate program is free and straightforward. You'll earn a 12% commission on every sale made through your unique referral link — no caps, no complicated tiers, just a flat reward every time someone you refer places an order. Commissions are tracked automatically and paid out monthly. The more your audience loves unique, personalised gifts, the more you'll earn.


• How to promote us:

The best way to promote Getfiguro is to show it. Share your custom figurine on Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube — unbox it on camera, show the before (your photo) and after (the figurine), and let your audience see the magic for themselves. Getfiguro content performs exceptionally well as a gift reveal or a "look what I made" moment. Use your unique referral link in your bio, story links, video descriptions, and blog posts. You can also use your personal discount code to give your followers an incentive to buy.

  • 1Share your figurine unboxing on TikTok or Instagram Reels
  • 2Post a "photo vs figurine" comparison — these go viral
  • 3Add your referral link to your bio and story highlights
  • 4Feature it as a gift idea in YouTube videos or blog posts
  • 5Use your discount code in captions to drive click-throughs


• Other information:

Selected affiliates will receive a complimentary Getfiguro figurine before their program goes live — so you can promote from genuine experience, not just imagination. We provide all affiliates with a branded affiliate portal where you can track your clicks, conversions, and earnings in real time. Our team is available to support you with product information, promotional assets, and any questions along the way. We ask that all promotions reflect Getfiguro's values: authenticity, creativity, and quality. Misleading claims or discount code misuse may result in removal from the program.
